outcome: Feasibility and acceptability of using a smartphone app to collect real-time qualitative data from women planning a vaginal birth after caesarean delivery
cohort: Seven women planning a vaginal birth after caesarean delivery
finding: The smartphone app provided real-time data, instant access to data, and the ability to access participants from a variety of locations, making it a feasible and acceptable method for collecting qualitative data.
mod_finding: The abstract focuses on the development and evaluation of a smartphone app for collecting qualitative data from women planning a vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
